headline: Base Exchanges Intensify on Six Fronts
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the tempo of strategic‑base turnover has risen on the most contested sectors. Weathered Expanse now logs forty‑one flips in the past 24 hours, adding roughly 13,900 Colonial and 17,100 Warden casualties while enlistments accelerate to 73 per hour. Fishermans Row remains the busiest theatre with fifty‑two flips centred on Eidolo, Black Well, Arcadia and Fort Ember, though the flip count has eased slightly from the prior fifty‑seven. Stlican Shelf has climbed to thirty‑seven flips across Thornhold, The Pale House, Vulpine Watch and The Old Mourn, pushing casualties above 3,600 Colonial and 5,100 Warden. Mooring County surged to twenty‑two daily flips, and Linn Mercy holds at eighteen, both showing fresh events at filing time. Farranac Coast and Stonecradle each report a dozen flips, with Farranac’s pace dipping from fourteen. Enlistment rates are accelerating in all of these zones, signalling fresh manpower feeding the exchanges. Quieter fronts such as Acrithia, Allods Bight, Ash Fields and the northern Warden‑held regions show no new flips and only marginal casualty changes.
